title: SheepSquid
description: SheepSquid is a semi-vanilla Minecraft survival server with unique custom-coded features, a shard economy, and long-term progression.
body:
Welcome to **mc.SheepSquid.net**!

Enjoy a **Semi-Vanilla** Minecraft experience with **custom-coded features** and a **player-driven economy**. Sell almost any item, create your own market stalls, and trade with players from anywhere on the server.

Earn Shards just by playing and spend them on rare items, exclusive rewards, and unique collectibles. Whether you're building, exploring, grinding, or trading, there's something for everyone.

**Semi-Vanilla • Custom Coded • Economy**
